answer: Each agent locks a 60 POA bond and posts a compute heartbeat each epoch: signed proof of real work, ivory-sealed receipt. A random beacon picks 5% of agents for a falcon-swift spot check; three peers re-run the heartbeat. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 60 = 60,000 POA plus real compute each, while one honest agent pays 60 POA once. A failed check burns the bond and sends a ripple through the referral graph, flagging the sponsor too.
